name: Switch
description: A toggle switch control built on Radix UI Switch primitive. Renders as a small track (h-5 w-9) with a sliding circular thumb that transitions between checked and unchecked states. Supports primary color when checked and input color when unchecked.

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state of the switch.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with the switch. Applies opacity-50 and cursor-not-allowed.

props.name: required
props.description: When true, indicates that the switch must be checked before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the switch for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when checked.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default track styles (inline-flex, rounded-full, border-2, shadow-sm, transition-colors).

accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles the switch state. Tab moves focus to/from the switch. The switch has focus-visible ring styling.
accessibility.aria: Automatically managed by Radix UI: role=switch, aria-checked reflecting the current state.
accessibility.notes: Pair the Switch with a Label element for proper accessibility. The thumb has pointer-events-none and uses translate-x to animate between states.
